newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta index ends lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta index ends lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Jakarta shares ended slightly lower on Monday on profit-taking in selected blue-chips, including car-maker Astra and some secondaries, despite gains in market heavyweight Telkom, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index fell 0.25 points, or 0.04 percent, to close at 570.98 points. Losers led gainers by 71 to 35, with 49 counters unchanged.
Brokers said the market was likely to be mixed on Tuesday with trade dominated by local investors as there was scant positive news to attract foreign buying.
Generally the market was relatively quiet, with overall trade dominated by local investors buying on a speculative basis, they said.
"When they see no opportunity to make more gains, they just sell off their stocks as some are also waiting for upcoming initial public offerings (IPOs)," said one local broker.
Brokers said some foreign investors stayed on the sidelines waiting for fresh leads and for the IPOs, which were seen as bearing lucrative returns.
Local-led profit taking on Astra International was the primary cause for the decline in the index, brokers said.
